answer: For a poll on an onyx jetty beside nectar gardens, each ballot escrows $1. The server rejects unfunded ballots and counts funded ones. It refunds deposits on the winning side and divides losing deposits equally among winning ballots; on a tie, it refunds all deposits. With 100 honest no votes, an attacker casting fewer than 100 yes votes loses $1 per ballot. Wealthy attackers can still prevail, and sincere voters can lose money.
